phase: predeclared architecture, budget and spatial-partition validation
initialization: CNN source pretraining uses source labels only, fixed40 epochs and final checkpoint; source weights shared across spatial partitions
target_sampling: nested random prefixes within each fixed700-reference sample; no class-based query selection
selection: all hyperparameters and epoch counts fixed before additional experiments; no target labels used for early stopping; each budget is the total target training annotation count
evaluation: weighted macro-F1/mIoU plus accuracy, per-class scores and support; development enrichment uses inverse class inclusion weights
ablation_interpretation: patch_cnn still sees five spectral bands; it removes the explicit center-spectrum MLP branch, not spectral information. Parameter counts recorded; no capacity-matched causal claim.
spatial_partition: same reserved512px test blocks and same test samples; redistribute only non-test blocks using benchmark class-support constraints; labels used to build benchmark partitions never used as target training labels unless sampled
final_test: one final evaluation batch for all predeclared models after model/source/data hashes are frozen; no fitting or selection follows test access
test_support_policy: report absent classes as unsupported and add metrics averaged only over represented ground-truth classes; a test lacking all7 classes cannot confirm seven-class superiority
external_scene: not available in downloaded repository; conclusions remain single-scene regional transfer
